tldr: 台股週一終場幾近平盤收 43,634.19 點（跌 20.65 點、0.05%），外資轉為淨買超約 80.4 億元、逢低承接，但連 4 日調節台積電，投信則中止連 23 個交易日買超。
台積電 6 月營收創新高達 4,426.8 億元（年增 67.9%），並傳明年起調漲晶圓代工價最高 10%，AI 晶片需求續強。
金管會對 7 家銀行採用內部評等法的准駁最快 7 月底公布，過關者 8 月起可望釋放放款與配息空間。
土地銀行成為第 25 家取得財管 2.0 執照的銀行，國銀競逐高速成長的高資產客戶商機。
國際上，美股走勢分歧、道瓊漲逾 260 點，惟 ASML、美光、SK 海力士 ADR 因中國 DUV 量產傳聞遭重挫；美國暫停對伊朗空襲，油價挫約 8%、跌破每桶 90 美元。

items.title_zh: 台股平盤作收，外資逢低承接卻續砍台積電
items.title_en: TAIEX ends flat as foreign funds bargain-hunt but keep selling TSMC
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週一終場收 43,634.19 點，微跌 20.65 點、跌幅 0.05%，在上週重挫後守穩關鍵支撐。外資由賣轉買、淨買超約 80.4 億元，逢低布局群創、聯電，但連 4 個交易日調節台積電；投信同時中止連 23 個交易日買超，法人操作趨於保守，顯示大盤在權值股與中小型股之間資金輪動、多空拉鋸。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark closed Monday almost unchanged at 43,634.19, down 20.65 points or 0.05%, holding above key support after last week's slump. Foreign investors flipped to net buyers of roughly NT$8.04bn, bottom-fishing in Innolux and UMC, yet offloaded TSMC for a fourth consecutive session. Local investment trusts, meanwhile, snapped a 23-session buying streak, signaling more cautious institutional positioning.

items.title_zh: 台指期夜盤震盪，盤前氣氛偏防禦
items.title_en: Night-session futures wobble keeps pre-market tone defensive
items.summary_zh: 週二開盤前市場情緒保守，台指期夜盤走弱，反映美股晶片股重挫的壓力。交易員指出，華爾街半導體疲軟與 AI 資本支出可持續性的疑慮為主要拖累；惟台灣景氣對策信號連亮第 7 顆代表熱絡的紅燈，景氣基本面仍強。多空訊號交雜下，預期今日盤面偏向個股表現、震盪整理，權值股走勢為觀盤重點。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Tuesday's open, sentiment stayed guarded as index futures slid in overnight trade, tracking a sharp sell-off in US chip stocks. Traders flagged the drag from Wall Street's semiconductor weakness and lingering worries over AI capital-spending sustainability, even as Taiwan's economic monitoring indicator flashed a seventh straight "red" light on booming activity. The mixed backdrop points to a cautious, stock-picking session rather than a broad directional move.

items.title_zh: AI 需求熾熱，台積電 6 月營收改寫新高
items.title_en: TSMC posts record June revenue as AI demand stays torrid
items.summary_zh: 台積電 6 月合併營收 4,426.8 億元，月增 6.2%、年增 67.9%，創單月歷史新高；第二季營收約 1.27 兆元寫季度新高，帶動上半年營收達約 2.40 兆元、年增 35.6%。法人估今年 AI 晶片營收有望突破 4,000 億元、占比接近全年營收四分之一，凸顯台積電在全球 AI 建置浪潮中的關鍵地位，也支撐台股半導體供應鏈的長線動能。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported June consolidated revenue of NT$442.68bn, up 6.2% month-on-month and 67.9% year-on-year, a single-month high. Second-quarter revenue reached about NT$1.27tn, a quarterly record, lifting first-half revenue to roughly NT$2.40tn, up 35.6% from a year earlier. Analysts estimate AI-chip revenue could top NT$400bn this year, near a quarter of total sales, underscoring the foundry's central role in the global AI build-out.

items.title_zh: 台積電傳明年起調漲晶圓代工價，漲幅最高 10%
items.title_en: TSMC seen raising wafer prices by up to 10% next year
items.summary_zh: 供應鏈消息指出，台積電已與輝達、蘋果等大客戶完成議價，先進與成熟製程基準價明年起調漲約 5% 至 10%。此舉可望抵銷海外擴廠帶來的成本上升、鞏固毛利，並在先進製程產能吃緊下強化定價力；同時反映 AI 與高效能運算訂單能見度延伸至 2027 年，對台積電營運與台股權值表現具正面意涵，惟客戶端成本壓力值得後續觀察。
items.summary_en: Supply-chain reports indicate TSMC has finalized base-price increases of roughly 5% to 10% across both advanced and mature nodes, to take effect next year, after negotiations with key customers including Nvidia and Apple. The hikes would cushion margins against rising costs from overseas expansion and reinforce pricing power amid tight leading-edge capacity, while signaling continued strength in AI and high-performance-computing orders through 2027.

items.title_zh: 金管會 7 銀行內部評等法准駁最快 7 月底揭曉
items.title_en: FSC ruling on banks' internal-ratings applications due by end-July
items.summary_zh: 金管會最快 7 月底公布 7 家銀行採用內部評等法（IRB）計提信用風險資本的准駁結果，過關者可望自 8 月起適用。內部評等法通常能降低風險性資產、釋出資本，進而擴大放款成長與現金股利發放空間，市場視為下半年銀行股評價的重要催化劑。此案牽動銀行資本運用效率，後續獲准家數與適用時程為觀盤重點，影響金融股籌碼與配息想像。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission is set to announce as soon as late July whether seven banks may adopt the internal-ratings-based (IRB) approach for credit-risk capital. Approved lenders could begin using the method in August, which typically lowers risk-weighted assets and frees up capital — expanding room for lending growth and dividend payouts. The decision is closely watched as a catalyst for bank valuations heading into the second half.

items.title_zh: 准駁過關可望自 8 月釋放放款與配息利多
items.title_en: Approvals seen unlocking lending and payout capacity from August
items.summary_zh: 市場評論認為，內部評等法一旦放行，將成為金融類股 8 月的潛在利多：過關銀行可取得更具彈性的資本、更大的放款成長空間與配息能力，替金控整體營運添增正面題材。惟分析師提醒，實際效益因各行獲准的模型範圍與資本狀況而異，投資人仍須留意利率走勢與資產品質變化，篩選受惠程度較明確的個股，避免一體看待整體族群。
items.summary_en: Market commentary frames the pending IRB green light as a potential August tailwind for the sector, arguing that banks clearing the review would gain more flexible capital, wider lending headroom and greater dividend capacity. The prospect adds to a broadly constructive backdrop for financial holdings, even as investors weigh interest-rate trends and asset-quality trends. Analysts caution that benefits will vary by each bank's model approval scope and capital position.

items.title_zh: 土地銀行成第 25 家高資產財管業務銀行
items.title_en: Land Bank becomes 25th bank cleared for high-net-worth services
items.summary_zh: 土地銀行獲金管會核准辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務（財管 2.0），取得一站式高資產財富管理執照，成為第 25 家開辦此業務的銀行。此一市場快速成長：截至 1 月底，21 家已核准銀行合計服務高資產客戶 21,543 人、資產管理規模突破 2.25 兆元。國銀競相搶進，反映高資產客群理財、信託與跨境資產配置需求升溫，財管業務成為銀行手續費收入的重要成長引擎。
items.summary_en: Land Bank has won FSC approval to offer "Wealth Management 2.0" financial products and services for high-net-worth clients, gaining a one-stop affluent-banking license and becoming the 25th bank cleared for the business. The market is expanding fast: as of end-January, 21 approved banks together served 21,543 high-net-worth clients with assets under management surpassing NT$2.25tn, as lenders compete for Taiwan's growing pool of wealthy investors.

items.title_zh: 7 月除息旺季，高股息 ETF 吸引追息買盤
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs draw yield-seekers into July ex-dividend season
items.summary_zh: 台股震盪之際，追求收益的投資人湧向高股息 ETF，本月約有 19 檔熱門 ETF 排隊除息，其中息率最高者年化約 18%。「現金稱王」的氛圍凸顯紀律型配息策略在波動盤勢中穩住資金動能，成為資產配置的防禦要角。惟分析師提醒，高股息不等於高總報酬，部分高息 ETF 的長線績效未必優於市值型產品，投資人宜兼顧息收與資本利得、控制單一標的比重。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan stocks choppy, income-focused investors are piling into high-dividend ETFs as a batch lines up for July ex-dividend distributions. Local reports counted around 19 popular ETFs going ex-dividend this month, with the top name offering an annualized yield near 18%. The "cash is king" tilt highlights how systematic dividend strategies are anchoring flows during volatile conditions, though analysts note high yield does not guarantee higher total returns.
